facts.pierced-heart: Three swords pierce a single red heart from above.
facts.blades-through: The tips of the blades come out below the heart.
facts.clouds-rain: Gray clouds fill the sky behind, and rain falls at a slant.

glosses.clouds-rain: Tears that come after pain; a passing rain.
glosses.no-figures: A picture that focuses on the heart itself rather than the event.

reversedGloss.waning: The pain thins little by little, as rain stops.
reversedGloss.internalized: Sadness cannot be shown and is swallowed inside.
reversedGloss.excess: Going over the wound again and again makes the pain bigger.

misdescriptions.wrong: Four swords are stuck in it.
The heart is split in two.
misdescriptions.regex: \b(?:split|broken|cracked|torn|cleaved|divided)\b[^.\n]{0,10}\b(?:in two|in half|into two|into halves|apart)\b|\btwo halves\b|\bin two\b|\bin half\b
